mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, SUM(total_amount) as amount FROM erp_order WHERE status != 4 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT product_name as name, SUM(quantity) as quantity FROM erp_order_item GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY quantity DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT p.category as name, SUM(oi.total_price) as value FROM erp_order_item oi LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.category
